user_story: As a user, I want to be blocked from logging in if my account is locked so that security is enforced.

positive.title: Successfully login with an active account
positive.expected_result: User is successfully logged into the account.

negative.title: Attempt to login with a locked account
steps: Enter a valid username for a locked account.
negative.expected_result: User receives an error message stating the account is locked and cannot log in.

negative.title: Attempt to login with incorrect password on locked account
steps: Enter a valid username for a locked account.
negative.expected_result: User receives an error message stating the account is locked and cannot log in, despite the incorrect password.

negative.title: Attempt to login with an incorrect username and correct password
negative.expected_result: User receives an error message stating the username or password is incorrect.

edge.title: Login attempt with no username and password
steps: Leave the username and password fields empty.
edge.expected_result: User receives an error message prompting to enter a username and password.

edge.title: Login attempt with special characters in username
steps: Enter special characters in the username field.
edge.expected_result: User receives an error message stating the username is invalid.

edge.title: Login with maximum allowed length for username and password
steps: Enter a username with the maximum allowed length.
Enter a password with the maximum allowed length.
edge.expected_result: User is successfully logged into the account if the credentials are active, otherwise receives an error message.
